title: 第13章 被抓第14章 血色眼眸
content_zh:
江平安第一次遇到这么强的对方，他打不过，果断逃窜。
可巨鹰从天而降，拦住去路，挥动翅膀将其扇了回去。
徐浩对着江平安疯狂进攻。
“此刀术就是我父亲在外求学带回来的，你这种刁民有什么资格学习！”
一刀刀劈在江平安的防护罩上，防护罩越来越暗淡。
“没有防护罩，你就是垃圾！”
徐浩一边攻击，一边贬低对方，以此来抬高自己。
“没有你父亲，你就是垃圾。”
即使几乎没有还手之力，但江平安还在抵抗，不到最后，他绝不放弃。
徐浩听到对方的嘲讽，脆弱的内心受到了极大的刺激。
“你找死！”
他一直想证明自己的优秀不是靠父亲，但总是逃不掉被父亲的照顾。
这对自诩优秀的人来说，是一种耻辱。
被人说出来，更是一种耻辱。
“嘭！”
徐浩全力攻击，砍在防护罩上，咔嚓一声，防护罩破碎。
“哈哈～死吧！你的机缘是我的了！”
徐浩神色狰狞，斩下最后一刀。
“一起死！”
江平安神情变得疯狂，手里的刀突然改变方向，放弃面前的攻击，斩向左边。

幻刀，并不是真的让刀虚幻。
而是一种视觉上的欺骗，在形成幻影之时，刀身从视觉盲点绕过对方的攻击。
只要知道幻刀的运转轨迹，再加上速度，就能挡住。
但是，江平安没打算抵挡，而是绕过对方攻击，从左边攻击，与对方一换一！
“噗~”
鲜血飞溅。
江平安的胸膛被击中，深可见骨。
但是徐浩没事。
一道金光在徐浩身上迸发出来，震飞了他的刀。
徐浩额头上滴下一滴汗水。
就差那么一点。
就差那么一点，要不是有保命符，他就死了！
content_en:
It was the first time Jiang Ping'an encountered such a strong opponent. He couldn't defeat him and ran away decisively.
But the giant eagle descended from the sky, blocked the way, and flapped its wings to flap it back.
Xu Hao attacked Jiang Pingan like crazy.
"This sword skill was brought back by my father who was studying abroad. What qualifications do you, a cunning person like you, have to learn it?"
A knife struck Jiang Ping'an's protective shield, and the protective shield became increasingly dim.
"Without a protective shield, you're just trash!"
Xu Hao attacked and belittled the other party in order to elevate himself.
"Without your father, you're just trash."
Even though he had almost no power to fight back, Jiang Ping'an was still resisting, and he would never give up until the end.
When Xu Hao heard the other party's ridicule, his fragile heart was greatly stimulated.
"You're looking for death!"
He always wanted to prove that his excellence did not depend on his father, but he could not escape being cared for by his father.
This is a shame for people who think they are excellent.
It's even more humiliating to be told.
"Bang!"
Xu Hao attacked with all his strength and slashed at the protective shield. With a click, the protective shield shattered.
"Haha~ Die! Your opportunity is mine!"
Xu Hao looked ferocious and cut off the last knife.
"Die together!"
Jiang Pingan's expression became crazy, and the knife in his hand suddenly changed direction, gave up the attack in front of him, and slashed to the left.
The phantom sword does not really make the sword illusory.
It is a kind of visual deception. When forming a phantom, the blade bypasses the opponent's attack from the visual blind spot.
As long as you know the trajectory of the magic knife and its speed, you can block it.
However, Jiang Ping'an didn't intend to resist. Instead, he bypassed the opponent and attacked from the left, exchanging one with the opponent!
"Pfft~"
Blood splattered.
Jiang Ping'an was hit in the chest, and the bones were visible.
But Xu Hao was fine.
A golden light burst out from Xu Hao's body, knocking his sword away.
A drop of sweat dropped on Xu Hao's forehead.
Just a little bit different.
Just a little bit short, if it weren't for the life-saving charm, he would have died!
